scripts.agent:publish: npm run agent:build && cd agent && npm publish
scripts.agent:publish:beta: rm -f 9remote-beta-*.tgz && NREMOTE_PKG=9remote-beta npm run agent:build && npm publish --workspaces=false --access=public 9remote-beta-*.tgz
scripts.web:deploy:dev: npm run secrets:sync:dev && npm run deploy --workspace=web -- --env dev
scripts.docs:deploy: npm run build --workspace=gitbook && cd gitbook && npx wrangler pages deploy out --project-name=9remote-docs
scripts.desktop:build: npm run agent:build && npm run tauri build --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:tauri: NINEREMOTE_ENV=development npm run tauri dev --prefix desktop
